commands: jar uf build/rhino-1.7.14.jar -C src/src org/mozilla/javascript/resources/Messages.properties -C src/src org/mozilla/javascript/resources/Messages_en.properties -C src/src org/mozilla/javascript/resources/Messages_fr.properties
notes: As the evaluation's jar was made: javac --release 11 of every .java file under the engine source directory src/ (no toolsrc/ or xmlimplsrc/; no dependencies), packed with jar cf, then the three message bundles org/mozilla/javascript/resources/Messages{,_en,_fr}.properties from src/ added with jar uf (Rhino throws MissingResourceException for any message without them); the project's Gradle build is not used. The commit is the 1.7.14 maintenance line (gradle.properties version=1.7.14), the parent of the fix. Fixed version: rhino 1.7.14.1, the first patched release of that line.
